title: 第5章 文华殿的老贼第6章 好妹妹的温柔陷阱
slug: 暮年太子每天增加一点精神
content_zh:
云璃月的车辇刚刚转过宫墙角，知道了里面发生的事情以后，檐下的宫人们便又窸窣低语起来。
“没想到连太子妃也劝不住老太子，若是任由老太子这样纵欲无度，只怕要不了一年半载，老太子就完了。”
“据说太子妃连陛下都搬出来了，还是没有让老太子停手，现在老太子已经疯了，连陛下都不怕了。”
“人之将死，什么事情都做得出来，老太子显然想要在临死前纵情欢乐，谁也劝不住的，我们只管看好戏就是。”
“宫里那么多人都等着老太子死呢，他自然要早点死比较好，这样我们也能够早点解脱，回到主子身边。”
……
宫人们还在嘲笑着夏无恙，并不知道在睡服了所有宫女以后，垂垂老矣的夏无恙就像是换了一个人，瞳孔中闪烁着摄人的光辉。
缓缓合上帷帐，他已经听到了外面的嘲笑和戏谑，等后续有机会的话，定要好好教训一下他们。
尤其是那些暗谍和内应，能杀的话，尽量都杀了。
这些年他们在东宫吃他的喝他的，竟然还敢背叛他，真以为他这个老太子已经昏聩到分不清是非，连刀剑也拿不动了吗。
子时的更漏声隐约传来，今晚无星无月。
等到所有宫女都已经睡下，夏无恙悄然进入文华殿的练功室，开始修行龙虎拳法。
鎏金灯树映照下，他身形舒展如老松迎风。
随着拳势不断展开，周身渐渐腾起龙形虎相的气血异象，在青砖地上投下斑驳光影。
不知不觉中就已经来到了瓶颈桎梏，他并没有耽搁，在积累和准备一番之后，就开始冲击瓶颈桎梏。
“轰隆隆……”
盏茶功夫过后，已经突破过一次的瓶颈桎梏再次被破开，如同吃饭喝水一般，并没有什么难度，甚至可以说是水到渠成。
比起上一次突破这道瓶颈的时候，何止容易了十倍。
七品初期！
炼肉境！

短短时间内，他就重新恢复了七品初期的修为，一块块肌肉重新变得匀称起来，腹部也浮现出了八块腹肌。
举手投足之间，超过两千公斤的力量轰然而动，再次让他感受到了久违的力量感。
在江湖上，只要能够入品，成为九品武者，便有资格称之为三流高手，八品为二流，七品的话就是一流高手。
寿命再次有所提升，身体越发康健，今日精神力量又增加了一点，连带着其它属性也有所增长。
满意地点了点头，开始适应暴增的修为和境界。
等到巩固和适应以后，眼看着时间还早，夏无恙取出一本典籍，准备再翻阅一遍之后，就开始修行。
游龙御凤身法（上部）！
顶级战技，大夏皇室秘传的身法战技，一旦修行到大成之境，身如游龙，翩若惊鸿，速度快到惊人，能够躲闪各种攻击，甚至出现龙凤虚影，干扰敌人的视线。
放眼大夏皇朝，也是数得着的身法战技，也是夏无恙年轻时候修行的身法战技。
当年他已经将其修行到小成之境，不过迟迟无法突破大成。
content_en:
Yun Liyue's chariot had just turned the corner of the palace. After knowing what happened inside, the palace people under the eaves began to whisper again.
"I didn't expect that even the Crown Princess couldn't persuade the old prince. If the old prince is allowed to indulge in such indulgences, I'm afraid that within a year and a half, the old prince will be dead."
"It is said that the Crown Princess even moved His Majesty out, but still did not let the old prince stop. Now the old prince has gone crazy and is not even afraid of His Majesty anymore."
"When a person is about to die, he can do anything. The old man obviously wants to have fun before he dies. No one can stop him. We just want to watch the show."
"So many people in the palace are waiting for the old prince to die. It is naturally better for him to die as soon as possible, so that we can be relieved and return to the master as soon as possible."
…
The palace people were still laughing at Xia Wuchang, but they didn't know that after sleeping with all the palace maids, the old Xia Wuchang seemed to be a different person, with a captivating light shining in his pupils.
Slowly closing the curtain, he had already heard the ridicule and joking outside. If there was a chance later, he would definitely teach them a lesson.
Especially those secret spies and internal agents. If you can kill them, try to kill them all.
They have been eating and drinking from him in the East Palace all these years, yet they dare to betray him. Do you really think that he, an old prince, has become so comatose that he cannot distinguish right from wrong and cannot even hold a sword?
The faint sound of the midnight watch could be heard, and there were no stars or moon tonight.
After all the maids had gone to bed, Xia Wuyang quietly entered the practice room of Wenhua Hall and began to practice the Dragon and Tiger Boxing technique.
Under the illumination of the gilded lantern tree, his body stretched like an old pine in the wind.
As the fists continued to unfold, a vision of energy and blood in the shape of a dragon and a tiger gradually rose up around the body, casting mottled light and shadow on the blue brick floor.
Unknowingly, he had reached the bottleneck. He did not delay. After accumulating and preparing, he began to attack the bottleneck.
"Rumble..."
After the cup of tea, the bottleneck that had been broken once was broken again. It was just like eating and drinking. It was not difficult, and it could even be said to be a matter of course.
It was ten times easier than the last time I broke through this bottleneck.
Early stage of seventh grade!
Meat refining realm!
In a short period of time, he regained his cultivation level at the early stage of the seventh level. His muscles became symmetrical again, and eight-pack abs appeared on his abdomen.
With every movement of his hands, more than two thousand kilograms of power surged, once again making him feel the long-lost sense of power.
In the world of martial arts, as long as you can enter the ninth level and become a ninth-level warrior, you are qualified to be called a third-rate master, the eighth-level is a second-rate master, and the seventh-level is a first-rate master.
The lifespan has increased again, the body has become healthier, and today the mental strength has increased a little, and other attributes have also increased.
He nodded with satisfaction and began to adapt to the sudden increase in cultivation and realm.
After consolidating and adapting, and seeing that it was still early, Xia Wuyang took out a classic and prepared to read it again before starting to practice.
The Flying Dragon and the Phoenix Body Technique (Part 1)!
The top combat skills are the body and combat skills secretly passed down by the Great Xia royal family. Once you practice to the state of great success, you will be like a swimming dragon, as graceful as a startling giant, and your speed is astonishing. You can dodge all kinds of attacks, and even appear as phantoms of dragons and phoenixes to interfere with the enemy's sight.
Looking at the Great Xia Dynasty, it is also a rare body and combat skill, and it is also the body and combat skill that Xia Wuyang practiced when he was young.
At that time, he had already practiced it to a small level of success, but he was still unable to break through to Dacheng.
